title: borbonia borbonia
intro: Borbonia borbonia, commonly known as Black Ironwood, is a tree species native to the Caribbean island of Hispaniola, belonging to the family Meliaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and as a purgative. The therapeutic actions of Borbonia borbonia include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties.
